plan: Given the rationality assumption, each bidder will bid slightly above the third-highest expected bid to win while paying less. With a value of $27, I aim to bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win. Assuming others bid close to their values, I estimate bids around $24-$26. Since this is the only round, I will aim to win the auction while minimizing costs. My private value is $31. To benefit, I must bid below $31, ensuring the cost is less than my value. A bid slightly above half my value, say $16, could deter others from overbidding while keeping potential profit. Bidding exactly $31 risks no profit or loss if I win.
